project_info.sector: IoT/Smart Systems (Multi-sector: Smart Cities, Industrial Automation, Healthcare)
project_info.network_architecture: Cloud-based IoT architecture with device communication layer using MQTT/CoAP protocols over TLS, message streaming through Apache Kafka, and serverless processing via AWS Lambda. Secure device-to-cloud connectivity managed through AWS IoT Core with certificate-based authentication.
key_components: Data Processing Engine (real-time analytics, anomaly detection)
